subhead: Emmanuel Macron arrived in the French North Atlantic territory on Saturday, where he will receive Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. The visit signals Canada's intent to distance itself from the US under Donald Trump.

Paris's Techno Parade turns up volume to protest law targeting free parties
subhead: After a two-year hiatus, the festive protest returned Saturday afternoon in a cheerful atmosphere. Organizers and participants voiced criticism of the Ripost law adopted this summer that imposes harsher penalties on self-organized raves.

title: Emma Heming Willis on her husband Bruce Willis's illness: 'Once I stopped being in denial, we've learned to just navigate the disease'
subhead: The actor learned he was suffering from a neurodegenerative disease at 67. Close to four years after the diagnosis, his wife describes how she coped with the illness and her new role as a caregiver.

title: At Loewe, Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez make their mark
subhead: Succeeding Jonathan Anderson as creative directors at Loewe, the two Americans have lived up to expectations, offering fashion that combines pragmatism, technical experimentation and respect for the codes of the Spanish luxury brand. They will show their spring-summer 2027 collection in early October in Paris.

title: Inside the Hamidovic clan's reign of terror over young female pickpockets in the Paris métro
subhead: They name their children Dior or Al Capone and love designer clothes and luxury cars. To maintain their lavish lifestyle, the men of the Hamidovic clan – a Romani family of Bosnian origin – have maintained a reign of fear over an army of young female pickpockets on Paris public transportation. One branch of the network is on trial in Paris from September 15 to 23.

A$AP Rocky, the rapper reinventing masculinity
subhead: Like many of his peers, the superstar grew up amid poverty and violence. Yet he stands apart in the rap world, rejecting homophobia and misogyny. A Chanel ambassador who embraces being 'Mr. Rihanna', he is both an heir to the tradition of Black dandyism and the embodiment of a masculinity less bound by traditional norms.

title: French public debt to reach new record level in 2027, exceeding 120% of GDP
subhead: The government submitted its draft budget bill to the High Council of Public Finances on Friday. The bill provides for new tax increases, which are set to be the main factor in reducing the budget deficit. The public debt, meanwhile, will continue to rise.
